# Dora: Explore and Play!

> An interactive learning adventure game for toddlers and preschoolers, featuring Dora the Explorer. Kids explore vibrant worlds, learn words (including basic Spanish), make music, and help friends. Free to download on iOS and Android.

Dora: Explore and Play! is a mobile learning game published by BUD STUDIO LTD. It is designed for young children (ages 4+) with simple, frustration-free gameplay built for small hands. The Dora the Explorer and Nickelodeon branding is used under license.

## Key facts

- **What it is:** An interactive, educational learning adventure game for toddlers and preschoolers, branded with Dora the Explorer.
- **Who it's for:** Young children, ages 4+ (ESRB 4+ age rating).
- **Key features:** Explore vibrant worlds, learn words including basic Spanish, make music, help friends, and enjoy fun activities. The app holds the ESRB Privacy Certified Kids' Privacy Seal and is designed to be safe for children.
- **Platforms:** iOS and Android.
- **Price:** Free to download, with optional subscriptions and in-app purchases that unlock extra content.
- **Languages:** English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese.
- **Publisher:** BUD STUDIO LTD (London, United Kingdom).
- **Contact:** support@budgetudios.com

## Download

- [App Store (iOS)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dora-explore-and-play/id6742843999)
- [Google Play (Android)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.budgestudios.googleplay.DoraDXP)
